RoseArt Memoji Jewelry Color N Shrink Deluxe Party Pack Arts & Crafts I like craft kits like this for the kids. I like them going outside and being able to entertain themselves without having things do the entertaining for them. And I like having crafts like this where they can sit indoors and make things that they can give away as a gift, or they can use it themselves.
With this MeJoji kit, they can make 5 bracelets and necklaces. They come up with their own designs so it makes them unique to who they are.
The older kids help the younger ones trace and color a design using the included pencils. I then take the colored pieces and put them into the oven so harden them up and shrink them. Then we just added it to a ring and then slipped a cord through. To hold the memoji into place, we knotted the cord around it so it stayed in one place and didn't slide around.
I did have some beads, from some other kit we had, and added those to the cord. Just something to fill in the space and to add a lot more color.
Some do come with the kit but, we liked adding more.
My box was also opened prior to us getting it. The piece of tape that is suppose to be holding it closed was peeled open and it was nasty dirty.
Only has 3 design sheets in it. A bit of a bummer. Reading how many others got opened kits, I wouldn't ever buy another kit. Wouldn't spend money on things that are opened and items missing out of it. And a big waste of time having to contact the company and returning it.
text_fidelity_b: RoseArt Memoji Jewelry Color N Shrink Deluxe Party Pack Arts & Crafts

text_fidelity_a: Nerf N-Strike Elite Firestrike This is my first external cocking blaster and I'm in awe of its range and accuracy.  Flat, in the house shots, are going from my kitchen, down the hall, and thru the family room and hitting the wall (45 feet!).  This is by far as well as my Rampage does. Accuracy is also superb.  I wasn't sure that such little cocking force was going to be able to shoot darts so far or fast.  This little gem will fire elite darts and whistlers.  It does not like streamlines and the suction cup darts.  The bullseye LED target light works pretty good in the dark, and seem to be accurate enough to nail a human size target at 30 feet.  I love the way the 2 spare dart holders seem to blend into the overall scheme of the blaster.  Hurray for nerf for attaching these to the packaging with easy to cut twine, rather than the usual zipties.  The included darts work in all blasters but are easily lost (especially when this blaster shoots them so far) so be sure to pick up extras (I use the Elite dart in all my blasters so I get the 75 pack to replace all the lost ones).  Please be careful when shooting poeple as a shot to the face can be surprisingly painful.
text_fidelity_b: Nerf N-Strike Elite Firestrike

text_fidelity_a:
Tedco 4D Vision Horse Model I bought this model for my 7 year old grandson who recently started riding and currently aspires to be a Vet. The model is small and some of the bits are tiny but manageable if one has reasonable dexterity. It is not for the easily frustrated as it requires patience and a thought to put together. The documentation is marginally helpful, and we used the picture on the cover more that we did the provided sheet for guidance. I also bought "Horse Anatomy (Dover Nature Coloring Book)" which proved a useful addition.
I worked with my grandson to put the model together for the first time. One of the small pieces had molding flash still attached which prevented it from fitting properly until the excess material was removed. The pieces will all fit together properly, but the final assembly is not terribly robust.
To reiterate, it was a bit of a problem solving exercise to fit the pieces into the correct spots, but we found the feeling of accomplishment worth the effort. I do not recommend this as a quick-assembly toy. There are better choices for that purpose. However, I do recommend it as a learning exercise for the curious child. It was fun to see my grandson made associations with his dog and human anatomy during the process. The finished product is suitable for display in a safe spot and can be disassembled and reassembled as long as one keeps track of all the pieces (you wouldn't want to lose his pancreas, would you?). I deducted a star for the less than great documentation.
text_fidelity_b: Tedco 4D Vision Horse Model

Disney Sorcerer's Arena: Epic Alliances Core Set | Strategy Board Game for 2 or 4 Players Ages 13 & Up | Featuring Disney and Pixar Characters & Villains | Officially-Licensed Family Game If there was one company I can confidently say I wouldn't have expected a skirmish miniature battle game to come from, it would be a Disney mashup. Ariel and Aladdin get out there and trade punches with Gaston? I wouldn't have thought.

But that's exactly what you have here. The character mashup is novel, and the board, pieces and cards are pretty good quality, although I am not a fan of the poorly implemented version of the "Heroclix" format you see on these acrylic minis. They look good, they're just a bit difficult to fiddle with.

The game is broken into chapters, and you can really start exploring the entire set starting with Chapter 2 rules, which are a good starting point for experienced gamers and older children as well.

I'm excited to see what could come from the expansions for this game and which characters they choose to add. I don't think there are going to be a lot of people who gravitate towards Dr. Facilier, for example, so some more fan favorites would be nice to see.

Generally speaking, I really like this game and I think it will make for a fun tactical combat game for people of any age to enjoy.
text_fidelity_b: Disney Sorcerer's Arena: Epic Alliances Core Set | Strategy Board Game for 2 or 4 Players Ages 13 & Up | Featuring Disney and Pixar Characters & Villains | Officially-Licensed Family Game

text_fidelity_a:
Kubros Despicable Me Minion Building Kit I am a Lego fan, but I kept that in mind as I reviewed this, not wanting it to make my review unfair.
So, lets start with the kit. The pieces do not fit together as well as Lego pieces do. That’s not a huge thing, but it’s a little annoying with some of the steps.
I have to say that the instructions are much better than Lego ones –MegaBlox devised a very clear way to show what piece to put, and where to put it. That was nice. However, they lace the style Lego shows – if this were a Lego set, it would be hollow – allowing things to go inside it – this set is solid, no room inside for anything. The feet fall off easily, which gets old fast.

Plus there are many “special” bricks that will limit the owners ability to make other things out of the set. Although, that is moot if you have a sizable MegaBlox collection already.

The finished piece is nice – a little boxy – think Minions meets Minecraft.

My issue is the price though. If you look at Lego sets (aside from brand ones like Disney and some of the collectable ones) the cost is around 10c per brick.
This set works out at almost 30cents per brick. Three times the cost of a comparably sized Lego set.
The quality does not warrant that price. Despite the added value of the Despicable Me brand. If it was rounder, more interactive, or had stronger feet I would be inclines to give it a better score

If the shortcomings don’t bother you, and your life *needs* all things “Despicable Me” then you will enjoy this.
If someone else is paying for it, you will find it a bargain.

Otherwise I would recommend you get your Despicable Me and building set fix from a better product.
text_fidelity_b: Kubros Despicable Me Minion Building Kit

text_fidelity_a:
Wild Republic Audubon Birds Canada Goose Plush with Authentic Bird Sound, Stuffed Animal, Bird Toys for Kids and Birders, 5 inches First thing I noticed was how close this stuffed goose resembled the real thing. Second, the sound effect was so realistic. And third, there was no way for the batteries to be removed. All three demands of mine has been met. Now I purchase a lot of duck and geese related items for the baby shower of my niece, my brother finally got a girl who though he was decent and good looking enough to reproduce with. So while I was confused on what Auntie of the year was going to give to my first born niece, I remembered all the years growing up where my brother tormented and made fun of. Then it dawned on me! I was going to gift all duck and geese related things to my niece so she will grow up loving them. Why you ask? Well I will share a story. Long ago, back in the mid 90’s my grandmother took my brother and I to the local duck pond to let us feed the ducks bread. I, obviously the intelligent one, knew to throw the bread as far away as I could away from me. My brother, a few fries short of a happy meal, threw it at his feet. Before he knew it all these mystical, beautiful beasts of the pond surrounded him. I remember him mocking me, “ you aren’t cool the ducks don’t like you”. And I can remember clearly him saying “ I AM THEIR GOD.” Then karma happened. All my Sunday school teaching happened as I sat in the car with my grandmother waiting for this false duck god to finish his loaf of bread it happened. Our almighty creater from above, the real God, spoke “There is no true God but me” and just like that my brother ran out of bed. These geese, realized he had no bread and he was a false prophet started to chant their battle cry! Next thing I knew, my brother started to get attacked by a mob of geese. Now he’s banging at my grandmother’s car door to let him in but she still laughing so hard she couldn’t reach over to unlock the door. (We didn’t have power doors during this time) I could of easily reached over and unlocked the door, but I sat back and watched this biblical lesson unfold in front of my eyes. Did you know geese have teeth on their tongue? He found out that day Eventually my grandma let him in and they surrounded the car for a good 10 minutes before they left to stalk their new prey.
That day I almost became an only child and that day changed my brother forever.

So yes this stuffed geese and all the other geese and duck related items from this seller is worth the money. It was amazing seeing a grown mad cowering in fear as he unwrapped every single duck and goose at his baby shower. His child is going to befriend the very creatures that almost murdered him in cold blood over a loaf of bread.
10/10 will buy from again.
text_fidelity_b: Wild Republic Audubon Birds Canada Goose Plush with Authentic Bird Sound, Stuffed Animal, Bird Toys for Kids and Birders, 5 inches

The Resistance I picked up The Resistance to play at family gatherings where mafia and werewolf didn't go over so well. People didn't like getting eliminated and didn't like someone needing to moderate/narrate the game. The resistance is best played with more people. The more the merrier definitely is true here. Some people will play as the resistance and some as spies. The spies are trying to sabotage the missions while the resistance is trying to complete the missions. The game has a mission leader who will pick which players are going to go on the mission. The game then opens discussion to all players to decide if that is the best choice of players for the mission.

Overall, We enjoyed the game, but when playing with only 5 players, it's a bit too easy and people don't really get into the discussion. When playing with 8-10 players, the game is a lot more fun as people really get into the accusations and deciding who should go on the different missions. Since people aren't eliminated like mafia and werewolf, people tend to enjoy this game more.
text_fidelity_b: The Resistance

text_fidelity_a:
Fisher-Price Disney's Jake and The Never Land Pirates - Jake's Musical Pirate Ship Bucky [Amazon Exclusive] My oldest son turns 4 in just over a week, and he absolutely LOVES this toy! It's one of the few toys that he goes back for again and again.

There are two doors on the ship. One is to the back of the cabin and one is over "tick-tock"(the crocodile) who pops out with the press of a button. These doors come off pretty easily, BUT they pop right back on just as easily. There's also 3 "missiles" that shoot out of the cannon on the front of the boat with the press of a button. These worked great for us, but to be honest, those small pieces get lost pretty quickly. My son usually plays with the ship without those.

My favorite feature is the pegs that are placed ALL over the ship. There are little holes on the bottom of Jake and Skully's feet, so you can place them on the pegs and hold them in place while playing. There's even a little clear bar at the very top of the ship that you can put them on, so it looks like they're flying. I think it's a really cool feature!! I also really like the "rocking" motion of the ship when it moves. It kind of wobbles back and forth to look like it's floating on waves.

My only complaints is the sound, first of all. The music sounds kind of like it's coming from cheap speakers, and I find it annoying. My son loves it and likes to press the buttons to hear the music and phrases. If you really didn't like that feature, the batteries could be taken out. (I haven't resorted to that, but it is an option, since my son knows how to swap the on/off switch). Secondly, I do wish that this set also came with Izzy and Cubby, instead of just Jake and Skully. There are stickers on the side of the boat of Izzy and Cubby to look like they are looking out the window waving. I guess that's an attempt to make up for not having them as figurines. I know that you can buy separate figurines, but I don't know if they have pegs on the bottom of their feet to work with this ship.

Overall, our whole family gives it 2 thumbs up! We all love it, and definitely recommend it.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Disney's Jake and The Never Land Pirates - Jake's Musical Pirate Ship Bucky [Amazon Exclusive]

B. Toys by Battat B. Jungle Jam - Toy Drum Set (Includes 9 Percussion Instruments for Kids) (BX1289Z) The leopard-faced conga drum is about 15" tall and 10" wide. The drum barrel has handles on each side for easy lifting (though everything is very light). The lid has ten large bells on it, and it can be removed from the drum and used as a tambourine. Stored inside are two snakes (drumsticks), two giraffes (maracas/rattles), a hornbill (water whistle--you fill with water in the hole in the head, then blow on the whistle for a warble sound), an antelope (slide whistle--you blow in the whistle while sliding the legs in and out to change the tone), and a crocodile (cabasa-clacker--you rotate the handle to make the drum play itself).

It's supposed to be for ages 2-6. My just-turned-1-year-old niece loves playing with this, and so do the adults. The only thing my niece couldn't figure out yet were the whistles. (The water whistle requires just the right amount of water and blowing angle to warble, otherwise it'll do a high pitched whistle.) Our house has become full of joyful noise. lol. Anyway, this set looks fairly sturdy and has been holding up to play just fine so far, but it's clearly a kids-level quality in terms of the sound.
text_fidelity_b: B. Toys by Battat B. Jungle Jam - Toy Drum Set (Includes 9 Percussion Instruments for Kids) (BX1289Z)

Melissa & Doug Melissa & Doug Blue's Clues & You! Mailbox Play Set We’ve never watched Blues Clues, but I still thought the concept for this toy was adorable for my preschooler. We love to get the mail, and we even have a friendly mail carrier that we wave to, so this seemed like a toy that would grab my kiddos attention.

I love the sturdy wood envelopes and stamps. I do wish the address/return address had actual numbers and small words (ex. 123 Blue Street, etc) instead of squiggle lines. Or better yet a place to write your own address to help kids learn where they live. I may end up getting some mailing label stickers and putting my own content on there. The stamps could have also had different prices listed so kids can learn about postage.

The mailbox itself is really nice with a working flag, but it does the potential to fall over if not careful. I’m giving this toy 3 stars because of the nice quality and unique concept, but I think there are some missed learning opportunities that would make this much more educational.

Monopoly Board Game The Classic Edition, 2-8 players I have many fond memories of playing "Monopoly" with siblings, cousins, and parents when I was child and then with my own family as an adult. This version is very close to the version I remember playing in the 70s. The game board and tokens are sturdy, and my favorite tokens from when I played as a kid are included - the dog, the horse, and the race car, along with the shoe, hat, thimble, iron, wheelbarrow. Two others are included that I don't remember at all - a cannon and a ship.

The game comes with rules for the standard, full length game. Players choose a token and go around the board purchasing property and building houses and hotels, hoping to force their opponents into bankruptcy. This game can be played by two or more players.

The property title deeds are still made of thin cardboard, but may be a little more flimsy than older versions. The money tray is even better than it used to be. It's made of plastic and seems like it will hold up much better than the old flat tray with the flimsy dividers that used to quickly fall apart. The only thing that is off for me is the color of the Community Chest cards. They are a yellow-orange color instead of the yellow I am used to. I don't know if the very first version of the game had cards this color or not, but this is the first time I've seen this.

If you're looking to replace your old game or haven't played the original version, you can't go wrong with this classic game.
text_fidelity_b: Monopoly Board Game The Classic Edition, 2-8 players

Tegu Robo Magnetic Wooden Block Set, Electric Aqua, 8 PIECE We received our first Tegu product in a Citrus Lane Subscription box. It was just 4 triangle shaped pieces. They were great, and I wanted to try more without getting a huge set in case they lost their luster with my son, which tends to happen with kids. We ordered this set to go along with the 4 pieces we already had.

The wood is lightweight and smooth. It is almost soft to the touch. The dyes used are non toxic. The magnets are safe since they are encased.

This set is great. My son likes robots, so the Robo look on the side of these blocks added to the fun. He can rearrange them into various new robots. We stick these in a busy bag for church, and they keep him occupied most Sundays.

We will most likely end up with more Tegu. The cost seems reasonable for a humanely produced toy made from quality materials.

The only problem we have is that sometimes the poles of the magnets don't line up, so they do not attract. We are used to Magformers and don't have that problem with those. I would still recommend these and consider them a go to gift for preschoolers.

text_fidelity_a:
Mattel Barbie Hairtastic Color Stylin Doll Since the first Barbie doll was created in 1959, little girl's have always loved to style/color Barbie doll's hair, and this fun to color hair Barbie is no exception. (I took my 1960's ponytail down, so she could look like Sleeping Beauty back in the day!) This gorgeous Color Stylin' Hair Barbie is a huge favorite with the grandchildren now.

Barbie comes with a suction cupped chair, comb, applicator brush, bowl, seven color swatches in 3 colors-3 pink, 2 purple and 2 orange, clip on foiler holder and rubberbands. Barbie is dressed in a glittery pink dress with shoes, necklace and belt. The color application is easy- seat Barbie in her chair, which doesn't move due to an ingenious suction cup bottom, wet the hair section you want to color, place the color swatch in the foiler, then clip the foiler to the wet hair and pull through. When you want to remove the color or color again, you just wash and dry the hair and you are ready for more fun.

There are a couple things you should know before using this coloring set: don't color near carpet, furniture, walls or clothes you don't want to ruin, as these colors can be a permanent stain for certain fabrics or walls. I laid down a cheap plastic tablecloth from the dollar store, so the girls had a great area to play on with no worries. I called Mattel, and found they do not sell extra color swatches, so once these are used up, they are gone, and to replace the colors, you would have to buy another doll. This is a shame, as they always sell accessories and extra hair swatches for the dolls with hair swatches that can be cut, so why not some inexpensive color swatches too Mattel?

The girls just love coloring, braiding and styling the gorgeous streaked areas of this Barbie's hair, so of course they want more colors- and even different colors too. As for something interesting I noticed, I bought another one of these dolls, as I have 2 granddaughters, and we immediately noticed one set colored darkly and another set colored very faintly. I looked closely at the boxes and what did I find on the backs of the boxes, but an expiration date! It says Best Used By and then a date which you need a magnifying glass to read. Reading the back of our boxes showed that one of the boxes colors was expired! That explains the faint color! Being a wonderfully fun to play with Barbie gives this doll 5 Stars, but color that is expired and having no refills brings her down to limited playability with the color, making this gorgeous Barbie a 4 Star doll.
text_fidelity_b: Mattel Barbie Hairtastic Color Stylin Doll
